scope: Moderation permissions and authorised persistence boundaries

implementation_review.feedback: Customer feedback is stored pending review and cannot directly change menus, ratings or recommendations.
implementation_review.business_review: Decisions require private reviewer authentication, bounded decision values and independent verification fields.
implementation_review.owner_corrections: Pending corrections stay pending and cannot mutate live Dish records.
implementation_review.media: Uploads remain pending/private until an authenticated reviewer confirms dish identity, dietary match and permission.
implementation_review.database_writes: Review updates are conditional on pending state, preventing repeated decisions from silently overwriting reviewed records.

covered: Private contacts and hashes are not exposed
Owner corrections do not edit live menus
Feedback validation, deduplication and rate limits
Media identity, permission and private pending state
Review races and repeated decisions fail safely

blockers: An authorised pending feedback, business-review or media record is required to verify a real persistence transition.
Founder reviewer access must be used privately; it must not be retrieved, displayed or committed by the automation.
No direct authorised read-only database connection is available in this execution environment for table-level persistence checks.
next_authorised_check: With founder reviewer access and a specifically approved disposable pending record, verify one decision transition, reread it, confirm reviewedAt/status persistence, and confirm a second decision returns conflict without changing the row.
